name: accuracy
text: The extra AoE2 accuracy of the siege shots of a unit at units, {unit: part} (Huns: Trebuchet +0.35, from 15 % to 50 %). combat.accuracy_command adds it to the key "accuracy" of data/units.jsonl and sends aoe accuracy.

name: age_gifts
text: The resources that the civilization gets at each new age, {resource: amount}. train.research gives them at the end of each age.

name: age_units
text: The free unit at the first own town center at the end of an age, {age: unit} (the Spartan Polemarch in the Civic and Classical Age). train.research spawns it.

name: also
text: Technologies with an effect on one more group of GROUPS too, {technology: group} (Bohemians: Fervor and Sanctity for the villagers). train.stats, train.speed.

name: any_elevation
text: 1: the buildings of 3 × 3 tiles or more stand on any elevation, except the buildings with the key "flat" of data/build.jsonl (the Town Center). build.level checks the height difference of the footprint (Thracians, AoE2 wiki "Elevation").

name: arrows
text: The factor of the base arrows of the buildings in each age (Dark, Feudal, Castle, Imperial).

name: attack_gold
text: The factor of the gold that units with the key "attack_gold" of units.jsonl make while they attack enemy units (Varangians: Varangian Guards 1.5). game/spoils.py.

name: aura
text: The own complete buildings that make the gatherers of some resources work faster near them and take these resources, {"buildings", "resources", "rate", "range": tiles from the footprint} (Thracian forts and towers). gather.Map.drop_site adds them to the drop sites, Gather.aura_rate gives the rate.

name: build
text: The build speed of the builders (a factor). build.rise multiplies the work of the builders (civs.build_rate).

name: build_of
text: The build speed of some buildings, {building: factor} (Sicilian fortifications and town centers). build.rise (civs.build_rate).

name: build_wonder
text: The build speed of the builders of a wonder (Spanish: 20 % for wonders). build.rise (civs.build_rate).

name: built_food
text: The food that a complete building gives, {building: food} (Saxons, Wu). civs.built_food.

name: built_units
text: The herdables that a complete building gives, {building: [unit, number in the Dark, Feudal, Castle and Imperial Age]} (Tatar sheep).

name: bushes
text: [count, food] of the forage bushes next to the town center at the start (Gurjaras: 2 of 175).

name: carry
text: The extra load of a villager, [[gather kind or null (all), extra]]: Aztec villagers +3, Goth hunters +15. Gather.limit adds it (civs.carry). The kind "ship": the load of a fishing ship (fleet.carry, Dravidians +15, #2333); "oyster": a villager at an oyster (#2465).

name: church_rate
text: [building, size of the square in tiles, factor]: the villagers in the square around a complete own building of this kind work faster (Georgian Fortified Church: 21 tiles, +10 %, once for two churches). Gather.work_time, build.rise and repair.rate multiply by civs.church_rate().

name: convert_range
text: The conversion range of the monks of the civilization in tiles, for each age [Dark, Feudal, Castle, Imperial] (Egyptian priests: +2 in the Castle Age, +3 in the Imperial Age). monk.near.

name: cost_per
text: The cost bonuses for each complete own building: [group of GROUPS, the buildings, the share less for each, the most share less] (Saxons: foot soldiers cost 5 % less per town center or castle, at most 20 %).

name: costs
text: The cost bonuses: [what, resource or null (all), change in the Dark, Feudal, Castle and Imperial Age]. What is a group of GROUPS (units), "buildings", "buildings but farms", "technologies", "ages", "BUILDING technologies" (the technologies of the menu of that building, #1925) or a list of names. A float multiplies the cost (0.0: free), an int adds to it. AoE2 rounds half up (35 × 0.75 = 26).

name: decay
text: The factor of the decay of carcasses (Jurchens: 0, the meat does not decay).

name: doctrines
text: The Recruitment Doctrines of the barracks, archery range and stable, [[name, factor of the food and wood cost, factor of the train time], ...] in the order of the switch, the first at the start (Macedonians: Balanced, Conscript, Mercenary). train.switch and train.doctrine read it.

name: drop
text: The factor of a load at the drop site: "food" for each food load (also of the fishing ships), "forage" for a load of a fruit bush only.

name: drop_extra
text: A second resource at the drop site, {kind: [resource, factor of the load]}: "hunt" (hunters and shepherds), "fish" (fishermen), "ship" (fishing ships). Varangians: +10 % gold, +5 % for the ships.

name: earlier
text: The buildings, units and technologies that the civilization has one age earlier (build.locked, civs.earlier).

name: economy_villagers
text: The free villagers for each economic technology (Wei). train.research spawns them.

name: elevation
text: The elevation factors of the damage (AoE2 wiki "Elevation"), changes of civs.ELEVATION_BASE: "up" multiplies the hits of a unit or building of the civilization from higher ground, "low" the hits that it takes from lower ground, "high" the hits that it takes from higher ground (Tatars, Georgians, Macedonians). combat.elevation and the plugin (aoe elevation).

name: extra
text: The second resource of a gather kind ("forage": a fruit bush), {kind: [resource, amount for each unit]}: Poles and Puru stone miners, Portuguese foragers, Shu lumberjacks. Gather.second adds it at each gathered unit.

name: faith
text: The factor of the speed of the monks that regain faith after a conversion (Muisca: 100 % faster). game/monk.py.

name: fallen
text: The part of the cost of a fallen own unit that the player gets back (Tupi). game/spoils.py.

name: farm_food
text: The food that a new own farm gets on top of FARM_FOOD (Sumerians +125). gather.Map adds it to Map.farm_food.

name: farm_upgrades
text: The factor of the food of the farm upgrades (Sicilians: +125 %). train.research.

name: free_relic
text: The free relics of the first complete own building of a kind, {building: relics} (Armenians: one relic in the first Fortified Church). monk.free_relic puts them into it.

name: garrison
text: The units inside a building, {building: units} (garrison.size).

name: heal_aura
text: The own complete buildings that heal the allied units of a group near them, {building: {"range": tiles from the footprint, "group": GROUPS, "rate": hit points per AoE2 minute in each age}} (Muisca Settlements). regen.aura.

name: heal_range
text: The factor of the heal range of the monks.

name: herd_food
text: Herdable animals in a building make food (garrison.pasture), {building: [size, a, b]}: at most size animals in each, a × ln(F / b + 1) food per AoE2 minute for F food of the animals in all of them (Gurjara mills: 10, 15, 200, AoE2 DE wiki).

name: housing
text: The population that a building supports in place of train.HOUSING, {building: population} (Chinese town centers 15, Inca houses 10). train.limit.

name: hp
text: The hit points factor of a building, {building: factor} (Persians). build.values and combat.setup apply it before the technologies (Masonry).

name: hp_age
text: The factor of the hit points of all its buildings, walls and gates in each age (Byzantines).

name: kill_gold
text: The gold for each military unit that a mounted unit kills (Mapuche). game/spoils.py.

name: last
text: Resources last longer, {kind: factor}: a gathered unit takes 1 / factor.

name: lead
text: The units whose shots lead a moving target as with Ballistics, without the technology (Spanish Cannon Galleons). train.lead_command, AoePlugin.lead.

name: loot
text: The part of the cost of a destroyed enemy building that the player gets (Danes). game/spoils.py.

name: more
text: Technologies whose effect change is multiplied, {technology: factor} (Varangians: Bloodlines and Caravan +50 %). train.stats, train.speed.

name: nomad_unit
text: The unit that the first town center of a Nomad start spawns in front of it (Huns: a tamed Hunnic Horse, a Minecraft horse with Tame). Gather.town_center summons it.

name: not_shared
text: The shared items of an ally that the civilization does not get (Turks: no Elite Skirmisher).

name: per_minute
text: A resource for each AoE2 minute of work of a gather kind, {kind: [resource, amount]}: Thracian hunters and shepherds 3 gold while they gather from animals.

name: policies
text: The policies of the town center that the player switches between, {"start": the policy at the start, "gold": the gold of the first, second and each later switch, "effects": {policy: changes with the keys "costs", "extra" and "kill_gold" (gold per kill of an enemy unit, spoils.kills, #2512)}} (Athenians: Economic, Military, Naval). civs.policy, train.price, train.research.

name: pop_cap
text: The extra population limit from an age on, [age, extra] (Goths: +10 in the Imperial Age). train.max_pop adds it, also to the population setting of the game.

name: predator_hit
text: The attack bonus of the villagers against predators (Magyars: they kill a wolf in one strike). civs.predator_hit, Gather.

name: regen
text: The regeneration of units: [group of GROUPS or a list of unit names, hit points per AoE2 minute in the Dark, Feudal, Castle and Imperial Age] (Polish villagers, Georgian mounted units, Wu infantry, Thracian elite skirmishers, Bengali ships). A third value: the rule counts only with no enemy unit within that many tiles (Puru cavalry, #2334). regen.tick gives them back.

name: relic_attack
text: [units, attack per relic in an own monastery, most] (Lithuanian knights and Leitis). game/monk.py.

name: repair
text: The repair rate (a factor). repair.tick multiplies the rate of the repairs of the player (civs.repair_rate).

name: repair_cost
text: The team bonus of the repair cost of buildings (Georgians). Siege units and ships pay the full cost (AoE2 wiki "Villager (Age of Empires II)"). repair.tick (civs.repair_cost).

name: repair_team
text: The team bonus of the repair rate (Saxons: "Repairers work 25% faster"): it counts for the civilization and its allies, and multiplies with "repair".

name: research_time
text: [technologies (a rule of has), factor of the research time] (Achaemenid stable technologies 50 % faster, Jurchen siege and fortification technologies 100 % faster, the Gothic Loom at once).

name: reveal
text: The enemy buildings that the player sees under the fog of war (fog.revealed): [building, true: only the ones of aoe2mc.json and only at the start of the game] (Mapuche castles, Vietnamese start town centers).

name: scout
text: The start scout of the civilization in place of the Scout Cavalry (Aztecs and Mayans: Eagle Scout, Gurjaras: Camel Scout). scout.swap at the start of a new game.

name: shared
text: The shared unique units of its team bonus: an ally of the civilization has them too ("Team bonus").

name: ship_work
text: The factor of the work rate of a fishing ship in each age, [Dark, Feudal, Castle, Imperial] (Japanese). fleet.rate multiplies by civs.ship_work().

name: sight
text: The extra line of sight of an own building in tiles, {building: tiles} (Chinese town centers +7). Gather.seen_tiles.

name: smith_units
text: [group of GROUPS, blacksmith technologies, times in the Dark, Feudal, Castle and Imperial Age]: the units of the group get the effect of each technology that many times, also when the test of the effect does not cover them (train.smith).

name: start
text: The start-resource bonus, {resource: change of START}. In AoE2 the bonus comes with the first town center (a Nomad start gets it later); here it is in the start stock. The extra villagers of the Chinese (+3) and Mayans (+1) are units of the map, not of the stock. Lithuanians: +100 food for each town center, here only for the first one.

name: start_buildings
text: The complete buildings of the civilization at the start of a new game, {building: count} (Georgians: a Mule Cart). start_buildings.place puts them next to the town center, free.

name: tech_gifts
text: The resources for each technology but an age, {resource: amount} (Spanish). train.research gives them.

name: tech_hp
text: [group of GROUPS, building, hit points]: the units of the group get the hit points for each technology of the menu of that building that the player has (the Aztec monks: +5 for each monastery technology).

name: texts
text: The bonus lines of the civilization and its team bonus, as in the game (AoE2 wiki, sections "Civilization bonuses" and "Team bonus"), {"bonuses": [line], "team": line}. techtree.open_menu shows them in slot 46: text only, the other keys hold the rules.

name: town_center
text: The resources that the first town center gives (Tupi +25 of each): in the start stock when the player has a town center at the start, else when its first town center is complete (build.rise).

name: train_rate
text: The train rate of unit groups: [group of GROUPS, factor, also the upgrades] (Aztec military units, Khitan skirmishers ...). train.seconds divides by civs.train_rate().

name: trains
text: More units that an own building trains, {building: {"lines": [unit line, ...], "time": the factor of the train time in each age (default 1), "after": the technology that the player must research first}} (Mapuche Settlements: the spearman and skirmisher lines; the Goth barracks: the huskarl after Anarchy, #2685). train.trains, train.slots, train.seconds.

name: transport
text: More units in a transport ship of the civilization (Saracens: +20). transport.size.

name: trap_food
text: The factor of the food of a new own fish trap (Malay 3×). gather.Map sets it (Map.trap_food).

name: twice
text: The technologies whose effect the civilization gets twice (train.stats).

name: unique
text: The unique unit of its castle (train.UNIQUE).

name: units
text: The bonuses of the land units of combat.STATS: [group of GROUPS or a list of unit names (#3827), value, change in the Dark, Feudal, Castle and Imperial Age]. Value is a field of combat.Stats or "speed" (the walk speed) or "bonus:CLASS" (the attack against a class of combat.Stats.classes, #2249; a float multiplies it, #2272). An int adds, a float multiplies ("fire 25 % faster" is the reload / 1.25). The value "bonus" with a float multiplies the bonus damage that the unit deals (Gurjara mounted units, Bohemian spearmen, #2248); the value "taken" is the factor of the bonus damage that the unit takes (Bengali elephants, Sicilian units: civs.taken(), the plugin applies it at each hit); the value "friendly" is the factor of the blast damage of own and allied units that the unit takes (Jurchen military units, civs.friendly(), #2418). train.stats applies them before the technologies.

name: volley
text: One more projectile in each shot of a unit, {unit: its attack, 0: the full attack of the unit} (the Armenian galley line and dromons). train.volley_command sends aoe volley.

name: work
text: The work-rate factor of each gather kind of Gather ("wood", "food" (forage bushes), "farm", "gold", "stone", "hunt", "sheep", "oyster": villagers and fishing ships at an oyster, #2465); a missing kind is 1. Gather.work_time divides the time of one unit of resource by it.

name: work_rate
text: The train and research rate of a building in each age, {building: [Dark, Feudal, Castle, Imperial]} (Persian town centers and docks). train.seconds divides the time of an item by civs.work_rate().
